text:
nora.sec: spotted unexpected principals on Vault's transit wrapping key during a quick audit. partner ingestion SA `partner-bridge@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com` appears in key ACLs. I didn't find a terraform change — looks like a console grant.

ben.ops: ugh. can you paste the member list and any console log snippet?

nora.sec: members found:
- vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- partner-bridge@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com  <-- unexpected

vault-bot: WARNING: transit/wrap-key used by mounts: backups, partners. 9 secrets engines reporting active wraps.

kai.eng: partner-bridge should never have been granted that role. timeline?

audit-bot: admin audit shows SetIamPolicy event on 2026-03-18 03:12:14 UTC by user admin@partner-ops.com. Data Access logs for KMS were not enabled for this keyring, so we don't have Encrypt/Decrypt counts.

ben.ops: immediate actions: 1) remove external principal binding (but keep old key active) 2) create a new temporary wrapping key with tight IAM (svc-rewrap + vault only) 3) enable KMS Data Access logs and sink to security project 4) canary rewrap a single partner object and verify checksums 5) schedule full rewrap in maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

nora.sec: agree. remove binding now and record the gcloud command in-thread for audit.

ben.ops: removal command (will execute):
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-key --location=global --keyring=transit --member='serviceAccount:partner-bridge@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```

kai.eng: I'll spin up `wrap-temp-3419876543` and prepare rewrap script. prefer not to do in-place streaming for big objects; we'll decrypt to stdout and re-encrypt to new key, preserve metadata. will test on a single file.

ben.ops: enable data access now and create sink: `gcloud logging sinks create kms-data-sink bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-security/datasets/kms_audit --log-filter='resource.type="crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt"'`

nora.sec: also add a log-based alert for IAM SetIamPolicy on keyRings: if seen -> page sec.

pagerduty: created on-call schedule entry for rewrap window and set escalation on log-based metric.

kai.eng: rewrap test command (canary):
```
OBJ=gs://partner-data/backups/2026-03-18/part-0001.enc
# decrypt -> encrypt to new key
gsutil cp "$OBJ" - | gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-key --ciphertext-file=- --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-temp-3419876543 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - "$OBJ".rewrap && gsutil mv "$OBJ".rewrap "$OBJ"
```

ben.ops: make sure to snapshot crc32c/MD5 before and after and store in incident doc. also watch for Vault wrap failures. rollback plan: repoint Vault wrapping config to old-key if >2% failure rate in 5m.

nora.sec: after rewrap we need to rotate any SA keys for principals that had access and audit external principal activity. if we detect downloads of decrypted data, escalate to Legal.

kai.eng: starting key create and will post resource name. will also open PR to terraform to prevent manual console drift.

ben.ops: executing removal now and posting result...

ben.ops: removal complete, admin audit entry created. no errors.

vault-bot: Incident INC-20260323-99 created. tasks: create temp key (kai.eng), enable data access + sink (ben.ops), canary rewrap (kai.eng + pagerduty), forensic timeline (nora.sec). Next update in 40m.

nora.sec: thanks. please post command outputs here as you run them so we have a clear trail. :thumbsup:
